audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats GNAR! as Mega's stun and never names Wallop, the W that Mega Gnar gets in place of Hyper — a 7-second AOE stun that is the ability actually punishing your engages. It also never says GNAR! only stuns against terrain, and the 'Get kited' don't carried unrelated text about burning a cooldown.
audit.why: Riot's W text: Mega Gnar rears up and smashes down, stunning enemies in an area, on a flat 7s cooldown. Riot's R text: enemies are thrown and slowed, and only those that hit a wall are stunned and take bonus damage. GNAR! is 90/60/30s, so it is near-permanent at rank 3.
audit.corrected: Key Ability Interactions and the cooldown block now name Wallop's 7s stun, the wall condition on GNAR!, and its 30s rank-3 cooldown; the kiting don't now says Boomerang Throw hits twice per cast.
